commit.message:
feat(browser): unified Work Graph — objective activation, admission resume, cross-plane projection (T2-5)

Closes the last two Closed Production Loop coordination breaks (work->execution
and coordination->unification) with four operator-facing pieces:

1. Edge POST /v1/devos/resume-admission -> devos_environment_resume_v1: the
   designed exit from the fail-closed admission fence. Operator-confirmed,
   generation-floor CAS is the authority (SQL), stale floor -> 409, before/
   after readback in the response.
2. Edge POST /v1/meta/objective -> compileMetaObjectivePlan (NEW
   src/meta-objective-compiler.mjs) + meta_orchestrator_plan_activate_v1: the
   operator door the disabled superstep activatePlan stub was waiting for.
   Compiles the objective against the CURRENT roadmap authority (baseline
   binding, alignment epoch, plan_generation CAS, companion-suffix rejection,
   dependency DAG validation with cycle detection, recursive scheduler-
   identity key scan mirroring the SQL jsonb_path_exists guards, string-only
   constraints/capabilities).
3. Shell commands DEVOS_RESUME / DEVOS_OBJECTIVE_SET via two new public
   client methods (devosResumeAdmission / metaObjectiveSet) on the same
   device-signed supervisor rail.
4. Unified Work Graph projection: the browser stamps its cross-plane epochs
   (fleet generation epochs, supervisor mesh epoch, cognitive causal-stream
   cursor) on the /v1/devos/cycle body; the edge composes the Objective->
   Milestone->Task->Claim->Effect view model (one bounded plan-snapshot read,
   leader-independent, never gates the cycle) and the cycle record carries it
   into the supervisor snapshot for the shell.

Tests: NEW test/devos-work-graph.test.mjs (15 tests: compiler contracts,
objective route happy/400/409, resume CAS happy/confirm/mismatch, work-graph
projection composition + degradation, cycle response carry, client transport,
shell wiring pins). Full suite: 3279 pass / 0 fail / 2 skipped. npm run check
green (compiler + meta-routes added to the chain).
